meta.name: Satoshium Glossary
meta.notes: Canonical glossary for Satoshium. Edit terms carefully; keep definitions calm, verifiable, and non-hype.

terms.definition: A long-term project building decentralized intelligence infrastructure anchored to Bitcoin-grade verification—so systems can be audited and trusted without relying on personalities.
Intelligence that retains agency under constraints and remains verifiable—able to operate without depending on trust in a single operator, institution, or narrative.
The practice of proving what happened and why—using logs, rules, and evidence—so decisions can be audited after the fact.
Governance enforced by explicit rules and cryptographic proofs rather than informal authority—so behavior can be constrained and verified.
A specific statement that can be evaluated. A claim is written so it can be labeled, checked, and referenced.
A short classification that summarizes confidence in an answer (for example: Verified, Likely, Speculative, Unknown) based on available evidence and reasoning.
